symptoms: 'o.' is not recognized as an internal or external command
'o' is not recognized as an internal or external command

evidence.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings
evidence.broken_echo_line: echo  R1 Independent GT Review — yalnız localhost
evidence.browser_gate: timeout /t 2 then start http://127.0.0.1:8766/ with no /health check

root_causes.summary: cmd.exe batch parser mishandles UTF-8 multi-byte characters (em dash U+2014 and Turkish ı U+0131) in echo lines, splitting the line into stray tokens such as o. / o.

Server was started via a short-lived wsl -e bash -lc session with nohup ... &. When that WSL session exits, the review process is not reliably kept alive as a visible long-running Windows-attached job, so port 8766 never serves.
Launcher opened the browser after a fixed 2s sleep and printed a false 'Tarayici acildi' message without verifying HTTP readiness.

non_causes: Canonical source video SHA/path was valid
Repo review server Python module itself was not the first failure mode observed by the user (browser never reached a live socket)

fix.server_window: start R1-GT-Server cmd /k wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-22.04 -- bash wrapper
fix.browser_policy: open only after Invoke-RestMethod health OK (max ~30s)
